newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wing Hang Bank to launch HK$1.2 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Wing Hang Bank to launch HK$1.2 bln FRCD.

text.p: Wing Hang Bank will launch a HK$1.2 billion floating rate certificates of deposit issue later this week, bankers said.
They said the issue will carry a maturity of three years and the all-in return is expected in the "low 40s" basis points.
Chase Manhattan Asia, Schroders Asia, Jardine Fleming Bank and Sakura Finance Asia are joint bookrunners for the deal.
Wing Hang Bank received a long-term rating of A minus from IBCA, the European credit rating agency, in early March.
Banking sources said Wing Hang will apply to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the issue as eligible for its Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
Eligibility for LAF makes an issue more attractive to banks because holders of the qualifying debt can engage in repurchase agreements with the Monetary Authority, increasing liquidity.
